'''Starter Deck II''' is the 15th expansion of [[Star Trek CCG 1st Edition]]. It is published by [[Decipher]] on 16 December 1998. The set consists of 8 promo cards. 

A Decipher "re-release" of a core product of Star Trek CCG, the Premiere starter deck, with a new Premiere rule booklet (version 1.1 with all Premiere rules updates to current at the time) included 8 new cards specially designed for Starter Deck II. Each of the new Premiere Starter Deck II packs contain 60 randomized white bordered unlimited edition cards from the original 363-card '''[[Premiere Unlimited '95]]''' set (2 rare, 13 uncommon and 45 common), 8 fixed black bordered new limited edition cards, and the Premiere rule booklet (version 1.1).

There are 12 sealed decks per starter deck box. 

The set was re-released on 15 March 2000. The cards have the same images but with a new copyright date of 2000. The 2000 edition can be found in boxes of [[Second Anthology (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Second Anthology]] and [[All Good Things]].

==Additional Information==
*'''Starter Deck II''' was printed on 121 card sheets by TBC, USA.
*Each print sheet consisted of an 11 x 11 format.
*As part of a promotion with Activision, customers were sent a Starter Deck II deck when they pre-ordered the Star Trek: Hidden Evil PC game.
